title: El Mirador
description: The largest city of the Preclassic Maya, with some of the biggest pyramids in the Americas, is at its height.

title: Arrival of Siyaj K'ak' at Tikal
description: A lord linked to Teotihuacan arrives at Tikal, its king dies the same day, and a new dynasty is installed.

title: Tikal defeats Calakmul
description: King Jasaw Chan K'awiil I defeats the rival kingdom of Calakmul, restoring Tikal's power after more than a century of decline.

title: Last dated monument at Tikal
description: The last dated stela is raised at Tikal as the cities of the Maya lowlands are abandoned.

title: Alvarado defeats the K'iche'
description: Pedro de Alvarado defeats the K'iche' army near Quetzaltenango, where their leader Tecun Uman is said to have died, opening the Spanish conquest of the highlands.

title: First Spanish capital
description: Alvarado founds the first Spanish capital of Guatemala at the Kaqchikel city of Iximche.

title: Destruction of Ciudad Vieja
description: A mudflow from the Volcán de Agua destroys the capital, which is rebuilt nearby at what is now Antigua Guatemala.

title: University of San Carlos founded
description: A royal decree of Charles II founds the first university in Central America.

title: Fall of Nojpetén
description: Spanish troops storm the island capital of the Itza, the last independent Maya kingdom.

title: Santa Marta earthquakes
description: Earthquakes ruin the capital of Central America, and the Spanish authorities order it moved.

title: Guatemala City founded
description: The new capital is established in the Valley of the Hermitage.

title: Independence of Central America
description: A meeting of notables in Guatemala City declares the Captaincy General independent of Spain.

title: Central America declares itself a federation
description: After the fall of the Mexican Empire a congress declares the provinces of Central America independent of Spain, Mexico and every other power.

title: Republic of Guatemala declared
description: Rafael Carrera declares Guatemala a sovereign republic, ending its ties to the dissolved federation.

title: Liberal Revolution
description: The Liberal army of Miguel García Granados and Justo Rufino Barrios enters the capital, beginning reforms that favour coffee growers and take church and communal lands.

title: Eruption of Santa María
description: One of the largest eruptions of the twentieth century kills thousands of people in western Guatemala.

title: Fall of Estrada Cabrera
description: The dictator Manuel Estrada Cabrera, in power for 22 years, is declared unfit by the assembly and overthrown.

title: October Revolution
description: Officers, students and workers overthrow the military government and open ten years of elected reforming governments.

title: Decree 900
description: President Jacobo Árbenz's land reform law redistributes unused estate land, including that of the United Fruit Company.

title: Árbenz overthrown
description: President Árbenz resigns in the face of an invasion organised by the American CIA, ending the reforms.

title: Civil war begins
description: A failed revolt by junior officers starts the guerrilla movement and a civil war that lasts 36 years.

title: Earthquake of 1976
description: An earthquake on the Motagua Fault kills about 23,000 people.

title: Spanish embassy fire
description: Police storm the embassy occupied by Maya peasants and students, and 36 people die in the fire.

title: Ríos Montt takes power
description: A coup brings General Efraín Ríos Montt to power at the start of the most violent phase of the war in the Maya highlands.

title: Return to civilian rule
description: Vinicio Cerezo takes office as the first elected civilian president in sixteen years.

title: Peace accords
description: The government and the URNG guerrillas sign the agreement that ends the civil war.

title: Murder of Bishop Gerardi
description: Bishop Juan Gerardi is beaten to death two days after presenting a church report on the crimes of the war.

title: Ríos Montt convicted
description: A Guatemalan court finds the former ruler guilty of genocide against the Ixil Maya, a verdict set aside days later.

title: Pérez Molina resigns
description: President Otto Pérez Molina resigns and is arrested after months of protests over a customs corruption scheme.

title: Eruption of Fuego
description: Flows of hot ash and gas bury villages on the volcano's slopes, killing about 200 people.
